title: Northeast gets first region-specific antivenom for pit viper bites

ai.summary: Researchers developed India's first region-specific antivenom for Northeast pit vipers, addressing a gap in snakebite treatment where conventional antivenom covers only four major snake species.

facts.claim: Researchers developed India’s first region-specific antivenom targeting two medically significant pit viper species found in Northeast India
facts.quote: Researchers have developed India’s first region-specific antivenom targeting two medically significant pit viper species found in Northeast India, potentially addressing a major gap in snakebite treatment.

facts.claim: The antivenom was developed by a team led by Ashis K. Mukherjee, director of the Institute of Advanced Study in Science and Technology (IASST), Guwahati
facts.quote: The antivenom was developed by a team led by Ashis K. Mukherjee, director of the Institute of Advanced Study in Science and Technology (IASST), Guwahati.

facts.claim: It has demonstrated superior effectiveness against the venom of Pope’s pit viper (Trimeresurus popeiorum) and red-tailed bamboo pit viper (Trimeresurus erythrurus)
facts.quote: It has demonstrated superior effectiveness against the venom of Pope’s pit viper (Trimeresurus popeiorum) and red-tailed bamboo pit viper (Trimeresurus erythrurus).

facts.claim: The development is significant for the Northeast, where the commercially available Indian polyvalent antivenom is primarily designed to neutralise venom from the country’s four major venomous snakes — Russell’s viper, spectacled cobra, common krait and saw-scaled viper
facts.quote: The development is significant for the Northeast, where the commercially available Indian polyvalent antivenom is primarily designed to neutralise venom from the country’s four major venomous snakes — Russell’s viper, spectacled cobra, common krait and saw-scaled viper.

facts.claim: Its effectiveness against several medically important regional species is limited, leaving patients vulnerable to complications from their bites
facts.quote: Its effectiveness against several medically important regional species is limited, leaving patients vulnerable to complications from their bites.

facts.claim: The research team developed an equine-derived F(ab)2 bivalent antivenom using pit viper venoms collected in Mizoram and Meghalaya
facts.quote: The research team developed an equine-derived F(ab)2 bivalent antivenom using pit viper venoms collected in Mizoram and Meghalaya.

facts.claim: Pit viper bites can cause blood-clotting disorders, tissue damage and injuries to internal organs
facts.quote: Pit viper bites can cause blood-clotting disorders, tissue damage and injuries to internal organs.

facts.claim: The new formulation significantly reduced these effects in preclinical investigations
facts.quote: The new formulation significantly reduced these effects in preclinical investigations.

facts.claim: The study involved researchers from IASST, Premium Serums and Vaccines Pvt. Ltd., Amrita Research Centre, Delhi-NCR, Mizoram University and Aaranyak, Guwahati
facts.quote: The study involved researchers from IASST, Premium Serums and Vaccines Pvt. Ltd., Amrita Research Centre, Delhi-NCR, Mizoram University and Aaranyak, Guwahati.

facts.claim: The findings, published in the International Journal of Biological Macromolecules, highlight the limitations of a uniform antivenom strategy in a country with considerable regional diversity in venomous snake species
facts.quote: The findings, published in the International Journal of Biological Macromolecules, highlight the limitations of a uniform antivenom strategy in a country with considerable regional diversity in venomous snake species.

facts.claim: Snakebite is classified by the World Health Organization as a neglected tropical disease and a medical emergency
facts.quote: Snakebite is classified by the World Health Organization as a neglected tropical disease and a medical emergency.

facts.claim: The lack of effective antivenoms against several regionally prevalent species remains a major challenge in northeastern India
facts.quote: The lack of effective antivenoms against several regionally prevalent species remains a major challenge in northeastern India.

facts.claim: Mukherjee said further clinical and regulatory assessments would be required before the antivenom could be introduced for routine treatment
facts.quote: Mukherjee said further clinical and regulatory assessments would be required before the antivenom could be introduced for routine treatment.

facts.claim: The development could pave the way for more effective, region-specific snakebite treatment in the Northeast, where the conventional antivenom does not adequately cover the region’s diverse medically significant snake species
facts.quote: The development could pave the way for more effective, region-specific snakebite treatment in the Northeast, where the conventional antivenom does not adequately cover the region’s diverse medically significant snake species.
